evidence: To investigate the morphological characteristics of SnS 2 thin films atomic force microscopy (AFM; Park Systems, XE-100) was used. Precision ion polishing system (PIPS; Gatan 691) was used to obtain transmission electron microscopy (TEM; JEOL, 2100F) specimens and TEM was used to study exact morphological structure. To check the crystal structure of SnS 2 thin films, x -ray diffraction (XRD; X’pert PRO, PANalytical; Cu Kα radiation, λ=0.15 418 nm) was performed with 2 theta (2θ) mode. Also, Raman spectroscope (Renishaw, In Via Raman Microscope) was used to analyze the vibration properties. The chemical bonding was investigated by X -ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS; Thermo Fisher Scientific Co, theta probe base system; Al Kα, hv = 1486.6 eV ).
